answer: One extra identity costs a refundable 350 POA bond locked 100 days, plus a relic earned in thirty days of work, each day chained to the last, so a farm cannot run them in parallel. Each morning the registry sends a fresh beacon prompt, due within one hour, and a missed or copied answer resets the thirty-day clock. Three randomly assigned auditors check the agent's dune record, the public log of answers, once a week. A forged entry or shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year.
